**Publish gate report: Peppermint product page**

**Going out:** Product page copy for the peppermint tea, on the Pebblebrook Tea Co. site.

**Claims**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Just peppermint leaves, nothing else." | Product fact (ingredients), fine as written. |
| "Cool and clean after a big meal." | Describes taste and occasion, so it isn't a health claim. It would become one if extended to "aids digestion" or "settles the stomach", so keep it as is. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association." | On the policy list, exact wording. Certificate on file, renewed 2026. |

**Regulated claims:** Nothing on health, money, environment, children or prices. The "after a big meal" line is the only one near the health boundary, and it stays on the right side of it.

**House style:** Warm, plain and unhurried. No banned words, no AI tells (no stock openers, reversals or slogan closers). Score about 92/100, so no rewrite is needed.

**Disclosure:** This is the brand's own product page with no sponsorship, affiliate link, gifted product or AI-realistic imagery, so no label is needed.

**Fixed:** Nothing needed changing.

**Needs a decision:** Nothing unresolved.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead) must approve this exact copy before it goes live. I haven't recorded any approval. Once Sam says yes to this wording, he can run the approve step himself and we can retry the publish.
